_note: Quick actions per case type. Which three actions sit above a case is configuration of its case type: `quickActions` lists ids of the case page's header actions, in order. The case page reads it through nextcloud-vue `quickActionsFrom` (detail-quick-actions-from), which takes only declared header actions, so a case type picks actions and never defines one. A case type that lists nothing keeps the page's three. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.30.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.description: The actions above a case of this type, in order, by the id of the case page's header action. Empty keeps the page's own.
